items.title: MECH-180 redesign: write-count-decoupled sws_slot_diversity DV (supersedes V3-EXQ-845)
items.note:
Redesign of V3-EXQ-845's spindle-density DV, per user-confirmed autopsy routing (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-845_2026-08-01.md: "Mixed + redesign the DV"). 845 was the FIRST ecological end-to-end test of MECH-180's two links (novelty->MEL, MEL->consolidation) run together; readiness fully met, and 2/3 predicted DVs (cumulative_sws_writes, cumulative_rem_rollouts) showed clean monotone dose-response in 2/3 seeds and ON>OFF in 3/3 seeds -- genuine partial support, the first positive end-to-end signal this claim has produced. The third DV (mean_sws_slot_diversity, 'spindle density') inverted in all 3 seeds and alone failed 845's blanket C2 AND-gate, collapsing the whole run to non_contributory despite the other two DVs being clean and positive. Autopsy-confirmed root cause: sws_slot_diversity was computed as mean pairwise cosine distance across the WHOLE 16-slot, EMA-blended, persistent ContextMemory bank (ree_core/agent.py ~10148-10161; ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py 39/73-80) -- higher MEL drives more writes into the SAME fixed-capacity store, mechanically shrinking whole-bank diversity regardless of real content-differentiation quality; the manipulated variable (write count) confounds the DV. recommended_epistemic_category = measurement_test_design_defect (NOT substrate_ceiling) -- the substrate demonstrably sustains the predicted coupling (2/3 DVs prove it).

THE FIX (this run): restricts the diversity readout to ONLY the ContextMemory slots actually written during the CURRENT measurement cycle (detected via a before/after snapshot of agent.e1.context_memory.memory bracketing each force_cycle() call), isolating differentiation QUALITY from consolidation VOLUME. This is candidate (2) from the autopsy's two options (restrict to newly-targeted slots), chosen over candidate (1) (normalize by write count) because dividing an already write-count-decreasing whole-bank statistic by write count would COMPOUND the inverse relationship rather than decouple it, whereas the touched-slot restriction is a pure, directly-justified readout change. Requires NO ree_core change: ContextMemory.memory is a plain nn.Parameter already read directly elsewhere in ree_core (e1_deep.py extract_cue_context/shy_normalise), and write() (e1_deep.py:73-80) touches exactly the argmin-scored slot per call via an in-place EMA blend, so a before/after diff exactly recovers the touched-slot set. Re-verified this session (not merely assumed from 845) that no OTHER writer touches ContextMemory.memory during a measurement cycle for this config: sd016_writepath_mode defaults 'off' (unset here, as in 845) so the per-tick waking write hook (agent.py ~4491-4510) is inactive; shy_enabled defaults False (unset here) so enter_sws_mode() does not call e1.shy_normalise (which would decay ALL slots toward their mean and destroy the diff's selectivity); force_cycle()'s replay_sampler/routing_gate/aggregator branch is inert since use_sleep_aggregation_cluster is never set by this driver. Legacy whole-bank statistic retained as a non-gating diagnostic (mean_sws_slot_diversity_wholebank_legacy) for cross-lineage comparability; C1b/C2's spindle-density leg now gates on mean_sws_new_slot_diversity. Everything else (arms, seeds, env, C1a/C1c, R1/R2, INTERPRETATION GRID) is IDENTICAL to 845.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4, this session): checked 845's manifest directly (v3_exq_845_..._20260731T235634Z_v3.json, arm_results[i] keys) -- it records only per-cycle scalar aggregates (per_cycle_diversity = whole-bank stat, per_cycle_sws = write count) and NEVER recorded which ContextMemory slot indices were written nor any raw memory-tensor snapshot at any cycle boundary. The decisive readout for this run (diversity among only this-cycle's touched slots) is therefore NOT recoverable by post-hoc reanalysis of 845 -- proceeds to a new run.

Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b, this session): grep-count script against REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_*.json for MECH-180 -> count = 3 (V3-EXQ-677/718/718a, all substrate_ceiling/producer-gap class) >= threshold 2. UNCHANGED from 845's own docstring count. Brake was already RELEASED for this lineage in 845 (upstream substrate SD-MEL-PRODUCER VALIDATED); this redesign does not reopen that question, it repairs an instrument bug in the run that already tested the now-built substrate. 845 itself is not in the .json autopsy corpus the counter scans (it is a .md-only autopsy) and its recommended_epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect, not substrate_ceiling, so per Step 2.5b's per-category rule it would not add to the count even if it were -- this is the 'not braked' diagnostic-DV-repair case, not a same-ceiling re-derive.

Code review (Step 3.5, this session): claim tagging unchanged/re-verified (claim_ids=['MECH-180'], the only claim this run's implementation tests); EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE='evidence' correct (tests MECH-180 directly, matching 845); substrate API re-verified live against current ree_core source (run_sws_schema_pass, ContextMemory.write/memory, enter_sws_mode, force_cycle/_run_cycle all re-read in full this session, not assumed from 845); phased training / seed threading / progress instrumentation / runner conformance / output contract / z_goal wiring (DEAD_Z_GOAL_STREAM_EXEMPT, verbatim precedent from 845/718a/798a) all inherited unchanged and re-checked; new touched-slot statistic guards n_touched<2 per cycle (excluded from the per-cell mean rather than defaulting to a write-count-correlated 0.0) and is recorded with n_touched/insufficient-cycle diagnostics for auditability. DV-symmetry (604c) declared in script docstring for the new statistic: touched-slot SET and CONTENT both depend on real sampled buffer indices via the scaled step count and shrinking sample stride, not a scalar offset/monotone-rescale/permutation of the manipulation.

validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming, 0 warnings of any kind (incl. 0 dead-z_goal-stream-warning -- exemption constant recognized; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog). Smoke (--dry-run, 1 seed x 3-arm subset NONE_ON/HIGH_ON/HIGH_OFF): all 3 cells complete, verdict PASS x3, manifest+sentinel written, dry-run-relocated with 0 evidence/ leak (confirmed no _861 files remained under evidence/experiments/ post-run). New statistic computed sensibly and cleanly distinct from the legacy one (e.g. mean_sws_new_slot_diversity ~0.032 vs mean_sws_slot_diversity_wholebank_legacy ~0.56-0.62 on the same cells), n_touched_slots_per_cycle 4-5 (0 insufficient-touched-slot cycles). readiness_frac=0.00 on the smoke dose is EXPECTED (matches 845's own dry-run note): the 3-arm smoke subset omits 2 of the 4 required ON_ECO_ARMS, so _seed_readiness's len-check fails by construction, not by threshold. validate_recording.py --strict: OK, 0 always-core gaps on the smoke manifest.

items.title: Q-040c dACC PE-weight delta correlation, config fix + pre-flight smoke gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-475b)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-475b in the goal_pipeline:GAP-4 Tier-1 cohort. 475b FAILed at precondition P2 (dACC engagement): 0/6 seed-x-arm cells showed any dACC firing (n_dacc_fires=0 throughout, confirmed via REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-475b_2026-08-01.md). Root cause code-traced: ree_core/agent.py gates dACC's forward pass on `self.dacc is not None and z_harm_a is not None`; z_harm_a stayed structurally None because 475b's _build_arm_config called _lib.goal_pipeline_tier1.build_config(env, gap4_arm) WITHOUT enable_affective_harm_stream=True (default False; that flag is what wires use_harm_stream/use_affective_harm_stream/z_harm_a_dim into the config on the gap4_operating branch) -- the exact V3-EXQ-620/625 measurement-artifact footgun build_config's own docstring names by precedent. FIX (only substantive change from 475b): _build_arm_config now passes enable_affective_harm_stream=True; run_seed_arm also now stamps env._exq_env_kwargs explicitly (was previously coincidental via the module default) since that flag's branch reads limb_damage_enabled off it. Everything else -- P1 MECH-269b V_s-gating precondition, the Spearman-rho(|PE|, dACC bias-magnitude) correlation statistic, seeds 42/7/19, the 2-arm ARM_vs_off/ARM_vs_on structure, acceptance thresholds -- is unchanged. Verified both directions this session: with the fix, preflight measured n_dacc_fires=20/20 pilot steps and the full --dry-run's two cells measured n_dacc_fires=[48,48] (nonzero, confirms engagement); a monkeypatched negative control (forcing enable_affective_harm_stream=False, i.e. reproducing 475b's exact bug) correctly raised PreflightDaccNotFiring with n_dacc_fires=0. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the dACC bias-magnitude vs precision-weighted-PE correlation WITH dACC actually engaging. `reanalysis_query.py query --readout rho_pe_vs_bias_magnitude --claim Q-040` returns exactly one manifest (475b's own), whose n_dacc_fires=0 in every cell -- nothing to reanalyze. items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance) -- f_weight attenuation ladder, committed-class entropy
items.note: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance, downstream of selection). Design of record: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-B + "P-B buildability resolution (2026-07-31)". claim_ids=[] (diagnostic; brake-exempt per fanout doc Section 4 -- P-B tests a different mechanism from Leg P-A, claim-neutral by design; not a re-derive-brake case).  (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = paired-by-seed committed-class entropy across an f_weight attenuation ladder, under the lateral_pfc-routed + CRF-ON + MECH-448/449-active matched-stack config. f_weight did not exist before V3-EXQ-852 (SD-085 landed ree-v3 main 12374fb, 2026-07-31). V3-EXQ-852 itself (ree-v3 995c7db) tested f_weight only under substrate DEFAULTS, not this leg's CRF-ON matched stack; no other manifest sweeps f_weight at all. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author.  (b) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): claim_ids=[], brake-EXEMPT per fanout doc Section 4 ("P-B/P-C/P-D are brake-exempt... P-B tests a different mechanism").  (c) SD-085 landing: ree-v3 main 12374fb ("SD-085: E3Config.f_weight -- weight on F (reality cost) in score_trajectory"). REE_assembly/docs/architecture/ sd_085_e3_reality_cost_weight.md. E3Config.f_weight: float = 1.0 (no-op default), multiplicative coefficient on F in E3TrajectorySelector.score_trajectory (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1190). Set directly post-construction (agent.e3.config.f_weight = X), matching the lambda_ethical/rho_residue sweep idiom -- not wired through REEConfig.from_dims().  (d) CORRECTED route source: this leg's matched stack uses modulatory_channel_route_source="lateral_pfc" (V3-EXQ-851's corrected value, ree-v3 3c5d45a9dd + substrate branch in ree_core/agent.py), NOT the design doc's original literal "gated_policy" text, which V3-EXQ-851's own erratum (design doc, "Erratum (2026-07-31)" section) proved does not route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel at all.  (e) NEW C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE gate: on genuine fresh-select P2 ticks (same latch-clearing discipline as C1g), confirms mean_f_weighted falls within a +/-2% interval of f_weight * mean_f_raw (agent.e3._last_traj_components), on a majority of seeds, on EVERY rung -- i.e. the f_weight knob genuinely rescales F through the FULL matched-stack pipeline at every attenuation level, not just at substrate defaults (V3-EXQ-852's scope). C1(a-g) reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851 (same names/thresholds) but re-scoped from "both arms" to "all four rungs" since CRF is now a matched constant ON everywhere (no OFF arm in this design); C1(d) is necessarily re-expressed as a direct magnitude floor (mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs > PROP_NONVAC_FLOOR) rather than a paired ON/OFF diff. C1_holds requires all eight sub-gates to hold at majority-of-seeds on EVERY rung. Any C1 fail on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict.  (f) DV-symmetry declaration (mandatory, 604c net): committed-class entropy is a function of the argmax action-class sequence. f_weight rescales ONE per-candidate-VARYING term (F -- not a broadcast scalar) relative to M/Phi in the score sum; neither a uniform additive shift (argmax-cancelling) nor a whole-score monotone rescale -- so it is NOT invariant under the committed-class DV's argmax symmetry and legitimately CAN change the committed argmin, at every rung.  (g) Declared-null three-branch map (NO weakens, claim_ids=[]): (1) any C1(a-h) fails on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, evidence_direction=unknown. (2) C1 holds on all 4 rungs AND C2 holds (F000-vs-F100 committed-class-entropy lift >= 0.05 nats on >=2/3 seeds) -> f_dominance_confirmed_h2_operative_ceiling, evidence_direction=non_contributory but a load-bearing GOVERNANCE ROUTING signal (ARC-062's behavioural retest should be gated behind an F-rebalance substrate landing). (3) C1 holds AND C2 fails -> f_dominance_refuted_as_sole_cause, evidence_direction=non_contributory; per the fanout doc's P-C resolution, H3 (competence/action-learning) is already "eliminated" in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json -- this branch corroborates the already-tracked H-observation-interface root rather than reopening H3. One finding during review: validate_experiments.py flagged a new anchor-reachability WARN not present on 851 (851 is experiment_purpose="evidence", which the lint skips entirely; this script is correctly "diagnostic" per the locked design, so the identically-shaped C1a-g/h preconditions newly trip it). Resolved with a documented ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT (the preconditions are live-measurement COUNT aggregates, not known-degenerate-reference anchors -- there is no predicate-vs-frozen-reference mismatch to guard against, matching the precedent set by V3-EXQ-852's own exemption reasoning for its one by-construction precondition).  (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): all 4 rungs x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x4, manifest written+cleaned. C1/C1h correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 851's own dry-run behaviour). Independently verified the C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE logic via a direct run_experiment() call: at every rung mean_f_weighted matched f_weight*mean_f_raw within the 2% interval exactly as designed (e.g. ARM_F000 f_weight=0.0 -> mean_f_weighted=0.0 bit-exact; ARM_F100 f_weight=1.0 -> mean_f_weighted==mean_f_raw exactly), confirming the knob-live check computation is correct before the real run. [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/455 writer_calls=455 goal_state_present=True n_agents=4 -- no writer defect (correctly wired, zero active_frac expected on the tiny dry-run dose).  (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 19 checks (0 anchor-reachability-warnings after the ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT addition; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog; 0 stale-e3-diagnostics; 0 precondition-recomputability; 0 dead-z_goal-stream; matches V3-EXQ-851's own fully-clean state).  Reuses V3-EXQ-851's matched-stack + C1(a-g) + latch-clearing machinery verbatim per the fanout doc's own instruction ("Leg P-B... hold the rule-apprehension channel ON and lateral_pfc-routed... as a matched constant"). items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value.
